snippet.title: Solitaire Battle - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Solitaire Battle is a roguelike on a solitaire board where the cards you pick up let you attack, synergize, and slay fantastical opponents!
Wishlist it on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3809320/Solitaire_Battle_Demo/
Follow on itch: https://diabolodev.itch.io/solitaire-battle
A roguelike deckbuilding autobattler inspired by games like Balatro and SNKRX! Pick and draw cards to trigger attacks and abilities, build decks with wild synergies, and face enemies who make you play solitaire in unique and strategic ways!

Become a dwarf who digs up cards to keep the opponent stunned, a knight who fills the board with shields, or a monk who waits for the right moment to unleash a powerful combo of attacks!

Wishlist and follow on Steam to be updated when Solitaire Battle releases!
